# WaifuAI Docs Hub

> Technical documentation hub for AI agents, developers, and builders. Part of the WaifuAI ecosystem on GitHub.

## Agent Resources

- [LLMS Full HTML](https://waifuai.github.io/llms-full-html/) — Aggregated HTML documentation bundles optimized for LLM ingestion
- [LLMS Full TXT](https://waifuai.github.io/llms-full-txt/) — Markdown code aggregation with TOC and line counting
- [Sitemap](https://waifuai.github.io/sitemap.xml) — Complete URL index of all pages

## AI / LLM Infrastructure

- [AI Benchmarks](https://waifuai.github.io/ai-benchmarks/) — LLM spatial reasoning evaluation (Maze Gauntlet) with leaderboard and OpenRouter multi-model testing
- [LLM Text Queue GPU](https://waifuai.github.io/llm-text-queue-gpu/) — Redis-backed async text generation queue for LLM inference via OpenRouter
- [Macro Language Model](https://waifuai.github.io/macro-language-model/) — CLI chatbot with modular personality system (tsundere, deredere, etc.)
- [Book Generator](https://waifuai.github.io/book-generator/) — Full book generator from a title prompt using OpenRouter
- [Biochem Framework](https://waifuai.github.io/biochem-framework/) — AI conversation benchmark scoring by estimated neurochemical impact
- [Reasoning Pricer](https://waifuai.github.io/reasoning-pricer/) — Token pricing models with reasoning analysis

## Waifu / AI Companion

- [Hermes Waifu](https://waifuai.github.io/hermes-waifu/) — Live2D animated waifu with expression controls and Hermes Agent integration
- [Waifu Chat API](https://waifuai.github.io/waifu-chat-api/) — REST API for waifu chatbot conversations with user management
- [Waifu Constitution](https://waifuai.github.io/waifu-constitution/) — AI alignment constitution and behavioral guidelines for waifu agents
- [Waifu Layer](https://waifuai.github.io/waifu-layer/) — Personality trait layering system for LLM waifu responses
- [Waifu LLM VRM](https://waifuai.github.io/waifu-llm-vrm/) — Python library (pywaifu) for Godot engine AI waifus with VRM support
- [Anime Subtitle Chatbot](https://waifuai.github.io/anime-subtitle-chatbot/) — Few-shot chatbot trained on anime subtitles
- [MCP Waifu Chat](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-waifu-chat/) — Conversational AI waifu with SQLite history (FastMCP)
- [MCP Waifu Queue](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-waifu-queue/) — Redis-backed async job queue for text generation
- [MCP Traits Matcher](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-traits-matcher/) — Personality analysis with Euclidean distance matching
- [Traits](https://waifuai.github.io/traits/) — Character/agent trait system with Manim animations

## MCP Servers (Model Context Protocol)

- [MCP Solana Affiliate](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-solana-affiliate/) — Solana ICO affiliate program with Blink URL generation
- [MCP Solana DEX](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-solana-dex/) — Basic Solana DEX order book management
- [MCP Solana ICO](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-solana-ico/) — Solana ICO with bonding curves, buy/sell, and discounts
- [MCP Solana Internet](https://waifuai.github.io/mcp-solana-internet/) — Pay-to-access payment system with expiry

## Solana / Blockchain

- [Solana Launchpad Ecosystem](https://waifuai.github.io/solana-launchpad-ecosystem/) — Multi-program Rust ecosystem for AI-driven tokenomics
- [Solana ICO](https://waifuai.github.io/solana-ico/) — Python CLI for ContextCoin ICO with linear bonding curves
- [Launchpad Skill](https://waifuai.github.io/launchpad-skill/) — Rust CLI for managing tokenized companies on Solana
- [Crypto Simulation](https://waifuai.github.io/crypto-simulation/) — Unified mathematical theory of token economy simulations
- [Sim Affiliate](https://waifuai.github.io/sim-affiliate/) — Token economy simulation with affiliate dynamics
- [Sim Airdrop](https://waifuai.github.io/sim-airdrop/) — Airdrop strategy simulation with tiered/lottery/uniform distributions
- [Sim Bonding Curve](https://waifuai.github.io/sim-bonding-curve/) — Agent-based bonding curve token economy simulations
- [Sim MCP Token](https://waifuai.github.io/sim-mcp-token/) — Multi-agent economic simulation with resource ecosystems

## NLP / Paraphrase

- [Paraphrase Generation](https://waifuai.github.io/paraphrase-generation/) — NLP paraphrase generation suite overview
- [Paraphrase Back Translate](https://waifuai.github.io/paraphrase-back-translate/) — Back-translation paraphrase generation
- [Paraphrase GAN](https://waifuai.github.io/paraphrase-gan/) — GAN-style paraphrase refinement loop via OpenRouter
- [Paraphrase GAN Utils](https://waifuai.github.io/paraphrase-gan-utils/) — Production paraphrase system with caching and REST API
- [Paraphrase Human Sentence Classifier](https://waifuai.github.io/paraphrase-human-sentence-classifier/) — Human vs. AI sentence classifier
- [Paraphrase NMT](https://waifuai.github.io/paraphrase-neural-machine-translation/) — TensorFlow 2.x seq2seq NMT with Luong attention
